name: Gästehaus Franz
beschreibung:
Peacefully nestled in Gmuend near Gerlos, the traditional Gaestehaus Franz provides cosy guestrooms with panoramic mountain views. Guests enjoy rustic charm and genuine alpine hospitality.

Hiking routes into romantic side valleys and the vast Zillertal Arena ski network are conveniently close.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Franz in Gmuend near Gerlos combines countryside serenity with quick access to Zillertal attractions.
